nyid zer na/ lam shes 'dzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/mtshon bya de'i phyir/ mkhas pa kha cig lam shes sbyor ba'i bsgom bya'i rnam par gyur ba'i 'phags rgyud kyi gnyen phyogs shes rnam gang zhig byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don phun tshogs sgrub par nus pa'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas pa de lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ zhes gsungs/gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam chodas can/ zur phyi ma der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rtags grub te/ lam shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzhan don ga༄ya bor sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs kyi rigs su gnas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi rtogs rigs su gnas par thal/ 'asnga da pa'i phyir/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi stong nyid rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/ lam shes kyi shes rnam yin par thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ kha cig rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i theg chen gyi mkhyen pa gang zhig lam shes sbyor ba'i bsgom byar gyur ba/ lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid zer na / 'di la skyon 'phen pa kha cig gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg dman gyi sgom lam chos can/ mtshan nyid kyi zur dang wa der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi 103

rgyud la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab med pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ bden gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i slob pa'i gang zag med pa'i phyir/ zer na mi 'thad de/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yang yin stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun par gyur ba'i slob pa med par thal/ gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg dman gyi sgom lam rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gi rgyud la stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab med pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ de yod par thal/ dman lam ༄/na du ma song ba'i byang sems sgom lam pa de de 'dra'i gzhi mthun pa yin pa'i phyir/ de gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab rgyud ldan gyi gang zag gang zhig de stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab rgyud ldan gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod gang zag gang zhig khyod kyi rgyud la bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la yang des rigs 'dre/ gzhan yang / bden gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i slob pa'i gang zag yod par thal/ byang sems mthong lam pas bden gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir te/ des kun rdzob bden pa yang mngon sum du skadags/ des don dam bden pa yang mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ rtags sla/ kha cig mkhyen gsum gang rung gi rnam pa sgom par 104

byed pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de skabs 'dir bstan pa'i lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ zer na/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / gnyis stong rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ chos can de dang gcig yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i lam shes yin na/ rgyu lam shes yin pas khyab zer na/ lam shes chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ kha cig byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi lam shes yin na / skabs 'dir dasngo sa su bstan pa'i lam shes yin pas khyab zer na/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems kyi mthong lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/rang lugs la lam shes kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyidadang rnyo spong /rang gi lugs ni/ lam shes kyi rnam pa sgom par byed pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ sems dpa'i rgyud kyi lam shes kyi dmigs pa'i chos la log phyogs su sgro 'dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs kyi gnyen wa'i mtshan nyid/105

rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i lam shes kyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gnyen phyogs shes rnam gang zhig byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don phun tshogs sgrub par nus pa de lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ rtsod pa spong ba la kho na re/ rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de / zhes pa'i rnam pa mtshon bya la byed rigs par thal/ skabs 'dir lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid 'jog pa skabs su bab pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/'dod na/ gzhung de sgra ji bzhin du khas len mi rigs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ zer na/ rtsa bar ma khyab bo/ /rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bshad pa/dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung ste/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam la brgya dang bcu yod de/ nyan thos la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sum cu rtsa bdun/ byang chub sems dpa' la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sum cu rtsa bzhi/ sangs rgyas la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sum cu rtsa dgu yod pa'i phyir/ mkhas pa kha cig rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la brgya dang bcu yod de/ nyan thos la yod 106

rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i lam shes kyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gnyen phyogs shes rnam gang zhig byang sems 'phags pa'i bzhed don phun tshogs sgrub par nus pa de lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ rtsod pa spong ba la kho na re/ rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de / zhes pa'i rnam pa mtshon bya la byed rigs par thal/ skabs 'dir lam shes kyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid 'jog pa skabs su bab pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/'dod na/ gzhung de sgra ji bzhin du khas len mi rigs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ zer na/ rtsa bar ma khyab bo/ /rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa bshad pa/dran pa nyer bzhag nas bzung ste/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam la brgya dang bcu yod de/ nyan thos la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sum cu rtsa bdun/ byang chub sems dpa' la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sum cu rtsa bzhi/ sangs rgyas la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sum cu rtsa dgu yod pa'i phyir/ mkhas pa kha cig rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa la brgya dang bcu yod de/ nyan thos la yod 106

pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa bdun/ byang chub sems dpa' la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa bzhi/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sum cu rtsa dgu yod pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ re zhig rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam du gyur ba'i de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa de sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen de sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su mi gan sa par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la kha cigarnam mkhyen gyis stodags par bya ba rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/'di la mkhas pa kha cig bum pa chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyis rtogs par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes pa'i rnam pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes rnam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ des na rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin na rnam mkhyen yin pas khyab zhes gsungs/ gong du dogs pa dpyad na/ shes bya chos can/ bden 'dzin gyi rnam pa yin na/ bden 'dzin yin dgos par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin na rnam mkhyen yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas 107

'phags pa'i rgyud la bden 'dzin gyi rnam pa med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod mi nus te/ de'i rgyud la bden 'dzin gyi rnam pa dang ldan pa'i blo yod pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyud la bden 'dzin gyi rnam ldan du skyes pa'i blo yod pa'i phyir te / de'i rgyud la bden 'dzin gyi rnam pa can gyi blo yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud la bden 'dzin gyi rnam pa shar ba'i blo yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen de de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa ma yin par thal/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam ldan du skyes na de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ ma grub na song / der thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa shar ba'i blo yin na rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pas ma khyab pashiwa phyir/ ma grub na/ rnam mkhyen 'dzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ sangs rgyas la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sum cu rtsa dgu med par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ gong gi mtshan nyid la rang lugs kyi skyon ni/ lam she sa kyis rtogs par bya ba lam shes kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid dang gzhi shes kyis rtogs par bya ba gzhi shes kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid du 'jog rigs par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ dogs pa lhag ma sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi skabs su dpyod/ 'asnga da na/ bkag zin/ kha cig rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa'i chos la log phyogs su sgro 'dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs 'gog pa'i ye shes de rnam mkhyen 108

gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam mkhyen yin pa ra thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ kha cig rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa'i chos la log phyogs su sgro 'dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs 'gog par byed pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi 'dzin stangs su dmigs pa de/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/rnam mkhyen 'dzin pa'i rtog pa chos can/ rnam mkhyen gyi 'dzin stangs yin par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/rang lugs la rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/rang lugs la rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa sgom par byed pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de/ sems dpa'i rgyud kyi rnam mkhyen gyi dmigs pa'i chos la log phyogs su sgro 'dogs pa'i sgro 'dogs kyi gnyen ngo'i mtshan nyid/rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa'i shes rnam mthar thug gang zhig sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i bzhed don phun tshogs sgrub par nus pa de/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/rtsod spong sngar bshad pa las shes par bya'o/ /109

nyan thos la'ad bdang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam so bdun bshad pa/de la thams cad shes pa nyid la/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos po la yongs su rtogs pa'i lam bzhi yod de / lus dran pa nyer bzhag tshor ba dran pa nyer bzhag sems dran pa nyer bzhag chos dran pa nyer bzhag rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig lus tshor sems chos bzhi la dmigs nas rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis gnyis kyis brtags te sgom par byed pa'i dran pa dang shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ dran pa nyer bzhag rgyud la ldan pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod par thal mtshan nyid 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dran pa nyer bzhag yin na lam zhugs kyi mkhyen pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ lus tshor sems chos bzhi la dmigs nas rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid gnyis gnyis kyis brtags te sgom par byed pa'i dran pa dang shes rab gang rung gis bsdus pa'i lam zhugs kyi mkhyen pa de dran pa nyer bzhag gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi yod/ sa mtshams tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ de'i 'og tu zhugs pa la brtson 'grus 'byung bas/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad 110

pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam la bzhi yod de/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba/ skyes pa rnams yang dag par spel ba/ mi dge ba ma skyes pa/ skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba'i yang dag spong ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed pa yod par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed byed yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dge ba ma skyes pa rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na rtsa bar ma khyab ste/ kho na re/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed byed yod par thal/ de skyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba yod pa'i phyir/ zer na yang ma khyab ste/ chos sku dang mtshungs ldan yod par thal de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ chodas sku rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / dge ba ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba yin na dge ba ma skyes pa skyed byed yin dgos par thal/ thal 'gyur dang po la khyab pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje chos can/ dmigs med la dmigs par thal/ de la dmigs pa'i snying rje yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ bdag med la dmigs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da mi nus te/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig spang gnyen la blang dor byed par spro ba'i brtson 'grus de/ yang dag 111

pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam la bzhi yod de/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba/ skyes pa rnams yang dag par spel ba/ mi dge ba ma skyes pa/ skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba'i yang dag spong ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed pa yod par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed byed yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dge ba ma skyes pa rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na rtsa bar ma khyab ste/ kho na re/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed byed yod par thal/ de skyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba yod pa'i phyir/ zer na yang ma khyab ste/ chos sku dang mtshungs ldan yod par thal de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems bskyed yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ chodas sku rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / dge ba ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i yang dag spong ba yin na dge ba ma skyes pa skyed byed yin dgos par thal/ thal 'gyur dang po la khyab pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi dmigs med la dmigs pa'i snying rje chos can/ dmigs med la dmigs par thal/ de la dmigs pa'i snying rje yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ bdag med la dmigs par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da mi nus te/ chos can de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig spang gnyen la blang dor byed par spro ba'i brtson 'grus de/ yang dag 111

spong ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ yang dag spong ba rgyud la ldan pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te / yang dag spong ba yin na/ lam zhugs kyi mkhyen pa yin dgos pa'i phyir/rtags 'bud/ rang lugs ni/ spang gnyen la blang dor byed par spro ba'i brtson 'grus su gyur ba'i lam zhugs kyi mkhyen pa de yang dag spong ba'i mtshan nyid/dbye na sngar ltar bzhi sku/da/ sa mtshams tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod/ rtsod pa spong ba la kho na re/ mi dge ba skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba'i yang dag spong ba chos can/ khyodad kyis mi dge ba skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong bar thal/ khyod de yang dag par spong ba'i yang dag spong ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'dod na/ khyod yang dag par yod par thal/ khyod kyis de rnams yang dag par spong ba'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa ni sems las su rung ba nyid du byed pas/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i lam la bzhi yod/ 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rgyud la ldan pa'i lam ma 112

zhugs kyi gang zag yod par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa yin na lam zhugs kyi mkhyen pa yin dbo/sa pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin du gyur ba'i lam zhugs kyi mkhyen pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bzhi/ sa mtshams tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na sku/da/ sems yongs su sbyang ba byas pa la/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon par rtogs par sbyor ba'i lam la lnga yod de/ byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur ba'i dad pa'i dbang po la sogs pa lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig rang 'bras 'phags lam skyed pa la rang dbang du gyur ba'i mkhyen pa rnam byang gi dbang po'i mtshan nyid zer ba mi 'thad de/ rnam byang gi dbang po rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ dge sems rgyud ldan gyi lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa gang zhig dge sems yin na rang gi 'khor du dad sogs dbang po lnga 'byung bas khyab pa'i phyir/ rtags 'bud/ rang lugs ni/ rang 'bras 'phags lam skyed pa la rang dbang du gyur ba'i mkhyen pa / byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur ba'i rnam byang gi dbang ngo'i mtshan nyid/ de la byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur ba'i dad sogs dbang po lnga yod/ sa mtshams tshogs lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na 113

yod/ dro ba la sogs pa thob pa la/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mngon par rtogs par sbyor ba dang 'brel ba'i lam la lnga yod de/ byang phyogs so bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur ba'i dad pa la sogs pa'i stobs lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig rang gi mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i mkhyen pa de/ rnam byang gi stobs kyi mtshan nyid zer ba mi 'thad de/ rnam byang gi stobs rgyud la ldan pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs rgyud la ldan pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ stobs drug rgyud la ldan pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te/ zhi gnas rgyud la ldan pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs la/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i mkhyen pa de/ byang tshulags so bdun gyi nang tshan du gyur ba'i rnam byang gi stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na lnga yod/sa mtshams tshogs lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ kho na re / rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo mngon du byed kha ma'i theg chen kun rdzob sems bskyed chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/rtags grub ste/ byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud la rnam byang gi stobs yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod mi nus te/ chos can de'i phyir/ zhes zer ro dro ba la sogs pa bzhi rtogs pa la/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' 114

dpyad pa gnyis/ dang spro ni/ mngon par rtogs pa'i lam la bdun yod de/dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag nas/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub yan lag gi bar bdun yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni kha cig bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du gsar du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa byang chub yan lag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ der thal/ 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ chos can de'i phyir/ gzhan yang / nyan thos 'phags pa yin na/ stong nyid mngon sum du sna gas pas khyab par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa gang zhig nyan thos 'phags pa yin na byang chub yan lag thob pas khyab pa'i phyir/ rang lugs la/ rang 'bras byang chub kyi rgyur gyur ba'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa de byang chub yan lag gi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bdun sku da/ sa mtshams cho gas lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ kho na re/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi 'bras bu chos can/ byang chub kyi rgyu yin par thal/ byang chub kyi rgyur gyur ba'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang chub rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ro/ /bden pa mthong ba yongs su shes pa la/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang 115

spro ni/ 'phags lam yan lag la brgyad yod de/ yang dag pa'i lta ba 'phags pa'i lam yan lag nas yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'phags pa'i lam yan lag gi bar brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig bden bzhi'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs zin goms par byed pa'i ye shes de 'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ chos can de'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ rang 'bras 'phags lam gyi rgyur gyur ba'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa 'phags lam yan lag gi mtshan nyid dbye na brgyad yod/ sa mtshams tshogs lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ rtsod pa spong ba la/ kho na re/ byang phyogs so bdun gyi ma mtha'i sa mtshams tshogs lam chung ngu nas 'jog mi rigs par thal/ tshogs lam chung ngu la gnas pa'i nyan thos kyi rgyud la yang byang phyogs so bdun med/ tshogs lam chung ngu la gnas pa'i theg chen rigs nges kyi byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud la yang byang phyogs so bdun med pa'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab te/ nyan thos dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i tshogs lam chung ngu la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud la byang phyogs so bdun yod pa'i phyir/116

byang sems la'ad bdang rjes su mthun pa'e rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sku bzhi bshad pa/lam shes pa nyid la gnyen po'i lam/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dir bstan gnyen po'i lam chos can/ khyod la gsum sku da de/ khyod la rnam thar sgo gsum mo da pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ rang lugs bzhag pa dang / rtsod pa spong ba gnyis/ dang wa 3/rang gi bsal byar gyur ba'i sgro 'dodags kyi zhen yul med par rtogs pa'i cad nas rang gi bsal byar gyur ba'i sgro 'dogs pa'i sgro 'aro/gas 'jo mas par nus pas rab tu phye ba'i mkhyen pa 'dir bstan gnyen wa'i lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na 'dir bstan gnyen po'i lam du gyur ba'i rnam thar sgo gsum mo da/ sa mtshams chorgags lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na sku/da/ gnyis pa la kha cig gang zag gi bdag med stodags pa'i byang sems kyi chorgags lam chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang chub sems dpa' la yod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i lam shes kyi rnam pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab/ kho na re/ rnam thar sgo gsum gang rung yin na gnyen po'i lam yin pas khyab par thal/ rjodar ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam par thar pa'i khyod mtshan ma med pa chodas can/ der 117

thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ dbus mtha' las/ stong pa nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi rnam grangs/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / rnam par thar ba'i sgo stong pa nyid kyang yin lam yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ rnam par thar ba'i sgo stong pa nyid yin na/ stong pa nyid yin dgos pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de yin na stong pa nyid ma yin dgos par thal de yin na do/nga pa nyid yin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ chos rnams kyi ngo bo bden pas stong pa'i stong nyid chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na / der thal/ chos rnams kyi ngo du rgyu 'bras gsum bden pas stong pa la rim pa bzhin du rnam thar sgo gsum du 'jog rigs pa'i phyir/ rnam thar sgo gsum shes pa dang / /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba ni dogs pa'o/ /sprul ba'i lam la gzugs kyi 'du shes rnam par ma bshig pa dang / zhes sku gas kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sprul ba'i lam la gsum yod de/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gegs sel sdug pa'i rnam thar rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig rnam thar gsum po 'di gsar du skye ba'i lus rten yin na mi yin dgos te/ gzugs med ces bya khams gsum 118

gyi / / rten can lhag ma mi las skye/ /zhes mdzod las bshad pa'i phyir zer na / 'gog snyoms gsar du skye ba'i lus rten can gyi gang zag yin na/ mi yin dgos par thal/ mdzod las/ 'gog pa dang po mi'i nang du/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ byang 'phags kyi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya yin na/ mi yin dgos par thal/ mi rnams kyi ni skyabs dag dang / /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/khyab pa song / kha cig gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar de/ bsam gtan gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi la brten nas skye zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/sems can gyi rgyud kyi gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug gi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems can gyi rgyud kyi gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi'i snyoms 'jug yin na/gzugs kyi rnam pa can ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes gser phreng las bshad do / / kha cig rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur ba'i bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rnal 'byor ba rang la gzugs can ma yin par 'du shes nye bar bzhag ste phyi rol gyi gzugs rnams la bzang ngan sna tshogs su lta bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud 119

la gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te / sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar de la sangs 'phags gzugs can du snang ba'i phyir/ kha cig gzugs sdug pa sprul ba la dga' ba dang gzugs mi sdug pa sprul ba la mi dga' ba'i nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gzugs snang thams cad sdug par ro gcig du mos pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i mkhyen pa de sdug pa'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid/ zer na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi sdug pa'i rnam thar chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtsho na bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gzugs snang thams cad sdug par ro gcig yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na / gzugs thams cad yid 'ong yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na / yid mi 'ong gi gzugs med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni / rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur ba'i rab mtha'i bsam gtan la brten nas snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa ci rigs las grol zhing sprul sgyur sna tshogs pa ston par nus pa'i rab tu phye ba'i mkhyen pa de/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi sprul lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gegs sel sdug pa'i rnam thar rnams su yod/sa mtshams theg chen gyi dbang du byas na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chen po yan chad dang / theg dman gyi dbang du byas na phyir mi 'ong lus mngon byed 120

dang gnyis ga'i cha las rnam par grol ba'i nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rgyud la yod par gyo/ser phreng las bshad do/ /mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i lam la / zhes sogs kyi skabs su 17ra ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa'i lam la lnga yod de/ gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi 'gog pa'i rnam thar gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni mkhas pa kha cig 'gog pa'i rnam thar dang 'gog pa'i lha/mas 'jug don gcig zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad de/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar dang 'das lam gyi gzhi mthun yod/ 'gog pa'i lha/mas 'jug dang 'das lam gyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir te/ rnam bshad snying po rgyan las/ rnam thar brgyad ni byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams kyi 'das lam gyi ngo rwa1ra skye nus pa dang 'gog snyoms 'das lam gyi stobs kyis jo ba pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam du bshad pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ rnam thar thob zin gyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi rang sa'i nyon mongs pas ma bslad pa'i mkhyen pa de/mthong chos bder gnas kyi lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ gzugs med kyi rnam mthar bzhi/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar gcig rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ ྅mor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni kha cig 'das lam la dgu sku/da de/ bsam gtan gzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug rnams su yod 121

pa'i phyir/ zer na/ bsam gtan bzhi 'das lam yin par thal/ khyodar ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de bzhi rgyud la ldan pa'i phyi rol ba yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du/ gzugs med bzhi 'das lam yin par thal/sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ gzugs med bzhi rgyud la ldan pa'i phyi rol ba yod pa'i phyir/ 'gog snyoms 'das lam yin par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/ ldan min 'du byed yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ mdzod las/ ldan min 'du byed bcu bzhi dang / /kun btus las/ ldan min 'du byed nyer gsum bshad pa'i phyir/ mdzod las/ mi ldan pa yi 'du byed rnams/ /thob dang ma thob skal mnyam dang / /'du shes med snyoms 'jug pa dang / /srog dang mtshan nyid rnams dang ni/ /ming gi tshogs la sku/gas pa yang / /zhes dang / kun btus las/ sems dang ldan pa ma yin pa'i 'du byed rnams gang zhe na/ thob pa dang / 'du shes med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / 'du shes med pa dang / zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/kho na re/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ 'das lam ma yin par thal/ ldan min 'du byed yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ mtshungs ldan 'du byed kyi phung po dang / mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi phung po gang rung gang zhig122

mtshungs ldan 'du byed kyi phung po ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de 'du byed kyi phung po yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ de phung po lnga po gang rung gang zhig de gzugs kyi phung po yang ma yin/ tshor ba'i phung po yang ma yin/'du shes kyi phung po yang ma yin/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa grub ste/ sems byung ma yin pa'i phyir/lnga pa grub ste/ gtso sems ma yin pa'i phyir/ gong gi rtags gnyis pa grub ste / sems byung ma yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ re zhig rnam mkhyen gtso sems yin par thal/ mig shes gtso sems yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/mig shes 'khor gyi tshor ba yod pa'i phyir te/ dbang shes 'khor gyi tshor ba yod pa'i phyir te/ yid shes 'khor gyi tshor ba yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ tshor ba med par thal/ dbang shes 'khor gyi tshor ba yang med/ yid shes 'khor gyi tshor ba yang med pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ kho na re/ gtso sems su gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen dang sems byung du gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen gnyis ka chos can/'das lam ma yin par thal/ ldan min 'du byed yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub zin/ kha cig de chos can/ ldan min 'du byed ma yin par thal/ shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog snyoms shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ de ye shes chos 123

sku yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ de'i rgyud kyi mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgu ye shes chos sku yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ mthar gyis ni/ snyoms 'jug dgu'i bdag nyid la/ /chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du de 'das lam yin par thal/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog sgoms de mthong lam rtse sbyor dang / byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog snyoms sgom lam rtse sbyor yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de'i rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam bsgyings de de yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ma grub na der thal/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ de'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings de de yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur//zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ yang de'i rgyud kyi 'gog sgoms de sgom lam rtsesbyor yin par thal/ de ltar gcig la sogs pa bor nas 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la thug pa'i bar du mi 'dra ba'i ༄/ nas 'bo/ bas mi 'dra bar 'gro ba zhes lha/gas kyi don grub pa'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab ste/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi thodan mo ngas med pa ye shes 〉〉sa sku yin par thal/ nyon mo ngas med la/ chos kyi sku zhes bcadad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'dod sems de sgom lam rtse sbyor yin par thal/ de ltar gcig logs pa bor nas zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i 121

sku yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ de'i rgyud kyi mthar gnas snyoms 'jug dgu ye shes chos sku yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ mthar gyis ni/ snyoms 'jug dgu'i bdag nyid la/ /chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du de 'das lam yin par thal/ byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog sgoms de mthong lam rtse sbyor dang / byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'gog snyoms sgom lam rtse sbyor yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de'i rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam bsgyings de de yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ma grub na der thal/ de nas seng ge rnam bsgyings pa'i zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ de'i rgyud kyi sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings de de yin pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ ma grub na/ der thal/ 'gog dang bcas pa'i snyoms 'jug dgur//zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ yang de'i rgyud kyi 'gog sgoms de sgom lam rtsesbyor yin par thal/ de ltar gcig la sogs pa bor nas 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa la thug pa'i bar du mi 'dra ba'i ༄/ nas 'bo/ bas mi 'dra bar 'gro ba zhes lha/gas kyi don grub pa'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab ste/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi thodan mo ngas med pa ye shes 〉〉sa sku yin par thal/ nyon mo ngas med la/ chos kyi sku zhes bcadad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi 'dod sems de sgom lam rtse sbyor yin par thal/ de ltar gcig logs pa bor nas zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de'i 121

rgyud kyi mig shes de sgom lam rtsesbyor ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'gog snyoms kyi mtha' dpyod gzhan rnams zur du 'chad do/ /shes pa yin na ldan min 'du byed ma yin pas khyab zhes smra ba mi 'thad de/ rang rig chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ mtshungs ldan ma yin pa'i 'du byed kyi phung po yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ der thal/ de dang mtshungs ldan 'du byed kyi phung po gang rung gang zhig mtshungs ldan 'du byed kyi phung po ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ des 'du byed kyi phung po yin pa'i phyir/ de phung po lnga po gang rung gang zhi ga de gzugs kyi phung po yang ma yin/ tshor ba'i phung po yang ma yin/ 'du shes kyi phung po yang ma yin/ rnam shes kyi phung sngo/ yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis sla/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa gang rung ma yin te / sems byung ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rig yin pa'i phyir/ lnga pa grub ste / gtso sems ma yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rig yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs kyi sbyor ba ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la sgras brjod rigs kyi lhu/ nas dbye na dgu yod de/ 'das lam du gyur ba'i bsam gtan bzhi/ 'das lam du gyur ba'i gzugs med bzhi/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam la sbyin pa la sku gas pa'i pha 1ril tu phyin pa bcu ste / zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam chos can/ bcu yod de/ phar phyin bcu yod 125

pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ slob lam na phar phyin bcu yod par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ slob lam gyi sbyin sogs skabs 'di'i sangs rgya sa nyid kyi lam yin pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi mthong lam bzod pa brgyad spong ba'i lam zhes pa'i skabs nas dngos su bstan pa'i spong ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir/zer na rtsa bar ma khyab/ gnyis pa ni kha cig sangs rgyas kyi lam yin na sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyis bsdus pas khyab zer na/ mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas kyi sar sgrod par byed pa'i lam yin na sangs rgyas kyi lam yin dgos pa'i phyir te / thar par sgrod par byed pa'i lam yin na thar pa'i lam yin dgos pa'i phyir rtags 'bud byas pa la/ kha cig sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i sar sgrod par byed pa'i lam yin na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i lam yin dgos par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sar sgrod par byed pa'i lam yin na/ sangs rgyas kyi lam yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'dod na/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod na / de chodas can/ 'phags pa'i lam yin par thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab ste/ sgra chos can/ mig shes kyi gzung bya yin par thal/ 'phags pa'i mig shes kyi gzung bya yin pa'i phyir/khyab pa sgrig 'dod mi nus so/ /kho na re/ nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chos can/ sangs rgyas kyi lam yin par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi sar sgrod par byed 126

pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi lam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab/ yang kho na re/ byang sems kyi tshogs lam chorshas can/ sangs rgyas kyi slob lam yin par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi lam gang zhig sangs rgyas kyi mi slob lam ma yin pa'i phyir/ dang po khas/ gnyis pa sla/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas su gyur ba'i slob pa yod par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi slob lam yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas zer na/ byang sems su gyur ba'i spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i gang zag yod par thal/ byang sems kyi spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i lam yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa song ma grub na/ der thal/ sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug yod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ sangs rgyas slob pa yod par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi slob lam sku/da pa'i phyir/ zer na/ sangs rgyas nyan thos yod par thal/ sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grig ma grub na/ der thal/ sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya yod pa'i phyir/thun mong mayin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sodagu bshad pa/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rnam pa ni shin tu phul du byung ba'i zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sangs 127

rgyas 'phags pa'i stobs sogs shes rnam so dgu cesas can/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin te/ shin tu phul du byung ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ mkhas pa kha cig sangs rgyas kyi stobs sogs shes rnam so dgu chos can/ thun cesangs ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin te/shin tu phul du byung ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa gang zhig sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ re zhig sangs rgyas kyi de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yin na/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas pas khyab par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud la rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam du gyur ba'i de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud la byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i mkhyen pa med par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/gzhan yang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas par thal/ stobs sogs shes rnam so dgu sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi byams pa dang snying rje chen sngo/ chodas can/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de rnams 128

rgyas 'phags pa'i stobs sogs shes rnam so dgu cesas can/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin te/ shin tu phul du byung ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ mkhas pa kha cig sangs rgyas kyi stobs sogs shes rnam so dgu chos can/ thun cesangs ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin te/shin tu phul du byung ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa gang zhig sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs/ re zhig sangs rgyas kyi de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yin na/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas pas khyab par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud la rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam du gyur ba'i de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud la byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i mkhyen pa med par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/gzhan yang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas par thal/ stobs sogs shes rnam so dgu sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi byams pa dang snying rje chen sngo/ chodas can/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rtogs rigs su gnas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de rnams 128

byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su mi gnas par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na ko sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud la byang sems kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i mkhyen pa med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyi sa pa ni kha cigarnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la sku da pa de/ thun snu/nga ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la med pa de/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/zer na/ stobs bcu chos can/ rang gi rigs 'dra mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la med par thal/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags sla/ 'dod mi nus te/ stobs bcu'i nyer len mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na / de chos can/ khyod kyi nyer len mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod par thal/ khyod rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig rang gi sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i rigs su gnas pa de/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ de gang zhig rang gi sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la med pa'i rigs su gnas pa de/ thun mong min pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ shes bya chos can/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la dran 129

pa nyer gzhag yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi dran pa nyer gzhag de/ rang gi sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i rigs su gnas par 'jog rigs par thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi dran pa nyer gzhag de/ rang gi sde tshan 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na song / der thal/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gzhi grub pa'i phyir/rtags khas/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi po de/ rang gi sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa 'og ma'i rgyud la yod pa'i rigs su gnas par thal/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la sku/ so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ ma grub na/der thal/ byang sems sa dgu pa ba'i rgyud la so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ so so yang dag rigs blo bzang / /sa de legs pa'i blo gros yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ sde tshan mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa codig ma'i rgyud la med pa'i rigs su gnas par thal/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/'khor gsum yin no/ /gzhan yang / thun mo/nga ba'i rnam mkhyen yod par thal/ thun snu nga ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam sku/da pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ mtshan 130

nyid de 'thad par bud/ 'dod na/ nyan thos dang thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen yod par thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te/ rnam mkhyen yin na sangs rgyas kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan yin dgos pa'i phyir/ kha cig thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa med zer ba mi 'thad de/ thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags bsgru bas zin/ kha cig thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin na spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i shes rnam yin pas khyab zer na mi 'thad de/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i shes rnam mthar thug gang zhig shin tu phul du byung ba'i mkhyen pa de/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa/ rang byung gi rnam pa sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa rnams su yod/ rtsod pa spong ba la kha cig so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam yin par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam de la bdun wa der 'byed rigs pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ sa dgu pa'i rgyud la so so yang dag rig pa bzhi med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / de 131

bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa de rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam yin par thal/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam la sngar bshad pa'i bdun po der 'byed rigs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na / theg chen gyi mthong lam bar chad med lam de de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ de la de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa shar ba'i phyir/ zhes zer ro/ /de la ni gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa dang / zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs de la bcu yod de/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i lhababs nas zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs kyi bar bcu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig rang gi mi mthun phyogs zil gyis galha/na nus pas rab tu phye ba'i mkhyen pa mthar thug stobs kyi mtshan nyid zer na/ mi 'thad de/ stobs rgyud la ldan pa'i sems can yod pa'i phyir te 1 rnam byang gi stobs rgyud la ldan pa'i byang sems yod pa'i phyir te/ rnam byang gi dbang po rgyud la ldan pa'i byang sems yod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/rang gi mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi bar mi nus pa'i mkhyen pa mthar thug de sangs rgyas kyi stobs kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu yod/ nga ni sangs rgyas so zhes bdag nyid zhal gyi 'ches ba dang / zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mi 'jigs pa la bzhi yod de/ rang don spangs rtogs dam bca' ba la mi 'jigs pa gnyis/ gzhan don spang gnyen 132

dam bca' ba la mi 'jigs pa gnyis ste bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin na rnam mkhyen yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de / byang 'phags kyi rgyud la rnam mkhyen gyis rnam pa sgom pa'i mkhyen pa med par thal/ de'i rgyud la de sgom pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum med pa'i phyir te/de'i rgyud la rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa chos can/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud la khyod rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum med par thal/ khyod rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ gnyis pa la rang lugs bzhag pa dang / rtsod pa spong ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dam pa'i chos ston pa la 'khor gyi nang du bag tsha ba med pa'i rab tu phye ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa de mi 'jigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rang don spang rtogs dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis/gzhan don spang gnyen dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis ste bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig nga ni chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes bdag nyid zhal gyis bzhes pa la chos 'di thugs su ma chud zhes chos mthun gyi rgol ba med par rtogs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa dang zhes bshad cing / 'di'i thad kyi mdo las kyang de ltar bshad pa la kha cig lung 'di sgra ji bzhin du khas blang du mi rung ste corshas thams cad sangs rgyas pa yod par thal/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams 133

dam bca' ba la mi 'jigs pa gnyis ste bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin na rnam mkhyen yin pas khyab zer ba mi 'thad de / byang 'phags kyi rgyud la rnam mkhyen gyis rnam pa sgom pa'i mkhyen pa med par thal/ de'i rgyud la de sgom pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum med pa'i phyir te/de'i rgyud la rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum med pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa chos can/ byang 'phags kyi rgyud la khyod rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum med par thal/ khyod rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ gnyis pa la rang lugs bzhag pa dang / rtsod pa spong ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dam pa'i chos ston pa la 'khor gyi nang du bag tsha ba med pa'i rab tu phye ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa de mi 'jigs pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ rang don spang rtogs dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis/gzhan don spang gnyen dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa gnyis ste bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ kha cig nga ni chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /zhes bdag nyid zhal gyis bzhes pa la chos 'di thugs su ma chud zhes chos mthun gyi rgol ba med par rtogs pa phun tshogs la mi 'jigs pa dang zhes bshad cing / 'di'i thad kyi mdo las kyang de ltar bshad pa la kha cig lung 'di sgra ji bzhin du khas blang du mi rung ste corshas thams cad sangs rgyas pa yod par thal/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams 133

cad du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na / ka ba sangs rgyas pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab te / yang dag par sangs rgyas yod par thal/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yod pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grig 'dod na/ yang dag par grub pa yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ rnam grangs dang chos kyi mtshan nyid dang / zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ so so yang dag rig pa la bzhi yod de/ bshad bya la chags thogs spangs pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis/ 'chad byed la chags thogs spangs pa'i mkhyen pa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig bshad bya dang 'chad byed la chags thogs spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i mkhyen pa so so yang dag rig pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ mi 'thad de/ sa dgu pa ba'i rgyud la so so yang dag rig pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/rang lugs ni/ rang gi bdag rkyen du gyur ba'i rab mtha'i bsam gtan la brten nas bshad bya dang 'chad byed la chags thogs spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa de/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam du gyur ba'i so sor yang dag rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bzhi yod/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba la/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ ye shes ma 'dres pa la gsum yod de/ dus gsum la chags thogs spangs pa'i mkhyen pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis 134

pa la kha cig skyes la 'gags pa 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ dper na/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po lta bu/ skyes la ma 'gag pa/ da ltar ba'i mtshan nyid/dper na da ltar gyi mi lta bu/ skye ba'i rgyu yod cing ma skyes pa ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ dper na/ stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bu/ 'di lha dbang blo'i 'grel ba'i dgongs pa yin/ zer na/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po chos can/ skyes pa yin par thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/'dod na song / de chos can/ byas pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na song / de chos can/ mi rtag pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na song / de chos can/ mi rtag pa ma yin par thal/ 'gag pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na song / der thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal sngo/ chos can/ ma skyes pa yin par thal ma 'ongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ 'dod na/ skyes pa yin par thal/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / bum pa zhig pa 'das pa yin par thal/ 'das pa yin pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na song /der thal/ 'das pa'i mtshan nyid yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ bum pa zhig pa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ma grub na song / der thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ ma 'ongs pa yin pa yod par thal/ ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/135

pa la kha cig skyes la 'gags pa 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ dper na/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po lta bu/ skyes la ma 'gag pa/ da ltar ba'i mtshan nyid/dper na da ltar gyi mi lta bu/ skye ba'i rgyu yod cing ma skyes pa ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid/ dper na/ stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bu/ 'di lha dbang blo'i 'grel ba'i dgongs pa yin/ zer na/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po chos can/ skyes pa yin par thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/'dod na song / de chos can/ byas pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na song / de chos can/ mi rtag pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na song / de chos can/ mi rtag pa ma yin par thal/ 'gag pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na song / der thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal sngo/ chos can/ ma skyes pa yin par thal ma 'ongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ 'dod na/ skyes pa yin par thal/ byas pa yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / bum pa zhig pa 'das pa yin par thal/ 'das pa yin pa yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na song /der thal/ 'das pa'i mtshan nyid yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ bum pa zhig pa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ skyes pa yin pa'i phyir/ma grub na song / der thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ ma 'ongs pa yin pa yod par thal/ ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/135

'dod na/ bum pa ma 'ongs pa de ma 'ongs pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/'dod na/ bum pa ma 'ongs pa chos can/ dngos po yin par thal/ khyod skyed byed kyi rgyu yod pa'i phyir/ ma grub na song/ der thal/ ma 'ongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ mkhas pa kha cig rang nyid dus gang du 'jog pa dasngoras po gang gi rang dus la stos nas bzhag dgos pa'i ltos par gyur ba'i dngos wa de'i dus su thal zin pa 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang nyid dus gang du 'jog pa dngos po gang gi rang dus la ltos nas bzhag dgos pa'i ltos par gyur ba'i dngos wa de'i rang dus su ma sleb pa ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid/skyes la ma 'gag pa yang yin rang nyid kyi don spyi 'char ba rang dus su thal zin pa dang rang dus su ma 'ongs pa'i chos gzhan gyi don spyi 'char ba la ltos mi dgos pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa de da ltar ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ 'das pa yin pa yod par thal/ mtshan nyid dang wa de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bum pa zhig pa de 'das pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ rang nyid dus gang du 'jog pa dngos po gang gi rang dus la ltos nas bzhag dgos pa ltos par gyur ba'i dngos wa de'i dus su thal zin par thal/'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ 'dod na/ de bum pa'i dus su thal zin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bum pa de rang nyid kyi snga rol du zhig zin par thal/ 'asnga da pa'i phyir/ ma 'ongs pa yin pa yod par 136

thal/ ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'alnga da na/ bum pa ma spruongs pa de ma 'ongs pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bum pa ma 'ongs pa chos can/ ma 'ongs pa'i mtshan nyid de yin par thal ma 'ongs pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ 'dod na/ de bum pa'i dus su ma sleb pa yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bum pa'i dus su thal zin pa ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da na/ bum pa skyed bzhin pa de bum pa'i dus su thal zin pa ma yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da na / bum pa chos can/ khyod skye bzhin pa de khyod kyi dus su thal zin pa yin par thal/ stu/da dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ 'das pa yin pa yod zhes kha 'cham du smra ba mi 'thad de/ shi ba yin pa sku/da par thal/ 'das pa yin pa yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ skal ba dang wa'i mi shi ba yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ skal ba dang po'i mi chos can/ 'das pa yin par thal/ shi ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ dngos med yin par thal/ 'das pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da mi nus te/ gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ skal ba dang wa'i mi chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud la srog dbang med par thal/ khyod shi ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ khyod kyi rgyud la yid dbang yod pa'i phyir te/ khyod gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/dus der zhig zin pa dus der 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ dus der skyes pa dang 137

dus der ma 'gags pa'i gzhi mthun pa dus der da ltar ba'i mtshan nyid/ dus der 'das ma 'ongs da ltar dus gsum po gang rung gang zhig dus der ma skyes pa dang dus der ma 'gags pa'i gzhi mthun pa de dus der ma 'ong sa pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi mtha' dpyod rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar na sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad kyi rnam pa dag dang / zhes pa la sbyor ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa de la bco brgyad yod de/ spyod pas bsdus pa drug rtogs pas bsdus pa drug 'phrin las kyis bsdus pa gsum/ ye shes kyis bsdus pa gsum rnams su yod pa'i phyir/'phags pa 'og ma rnams dang yon tan gyi rten gyi rigs cung zad kyang ma 'dres pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i rab tu phye ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ bco brgyad yod/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bshad pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / zhes pa'i don ni/ ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen chos can/ 'dir bstan de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/ de bzhin nyid la slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyi mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig debazhin nyid la slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyi mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid zer na/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi de bzhin nyid chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rtags ṭika gar gsal/ gzhan yang / theg chen gyi mthong lam bar 138

chad med lam chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ de bzhin nyid kyi rnam pa shar ba'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ ye shes chos sku yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bshad pa'i de bzhin nyid la slar mi ldang ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par bzhag pa'i ye shes de gzhung 'di'i dngos kyi bstan bya'i gtso bor gyur ba'i de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad la mnga' sgyur ba'i rang byung dang / zhes par/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ rang byung gi rnam pa yin te/ chos 'kho ra ma lus pa skor ba la dbang sgyur thob pas rab tu phye ba'i mthar thug gi ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa skor ba la dbang sgyur thob pas rab tu phye ba'i mthar thug gi ye shes de rang byung gi rnam par gyur ba'i shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa gsum ste zhes bshad par/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa yin te/ chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes de sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam par gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ gnyis pa ni/ kha cig thun mong ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam yod zer na mi 'thad de/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam yin na thun mong 139

ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam yin dgos pa'i phyir/ de yin na sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam par gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam yin dgos/ de yin na thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam yin dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de yin na chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar phyin pa'i ye shes yin dgos/ de yin na sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam par gyur ba'i rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam yin dgos pa'i phyir/ dang po 'bud/ gnyis pa gzhung dang ṭika /ra gsal/ de la thams cad shes pa nyid kyi rnam pa ni nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i bye brag gi/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang wa 3/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun la nyon mongs pa'i zag pa med pa zhes bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de / nyan thos slob pa 'phags pas nyon sgrib spang bya'i gatho ༷ ra byas nas spong ba'i phyir/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi shes rnam nyer bdun la nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas zhes brtags nas bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/byang sems 'phags pas nyon sgrib spang bya'i gatho rwaper byas nas mi spong ba'i phyir/byang sems kyi lam shes kyi shes rnam so drug la nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas su brtags nas bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan sku/da de/ byang sems 'phags pas nyon sgrib spang bya'i gatho rwakur byas nas mi spong bar nyon mongs gzhan don byed pa'i yan lag tu bsgyur bar byed pa'i phyir/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam brgya dang bcu chos 140

can/ zag med kho na yin te/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig nyan chodas kyi rgyud kyi gzhi shes yin na nyon mongs pa'i zag med yin pas khyab/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes yin na swārton mongs pa'i zag bcas yin pas khyab zer na/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes chos can/ nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas yin par thal/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ nyon sgrib ma lus par spangs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / byang sems mthong lam pa'i rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa chos can/ spang bya yin par thal/ nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na song / der thal/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ kha cig rang rgyal slob pa 'phags pas nyon sgrib spang bya'i gtso bor byas nas mi spong zhes zer na/ mi 'thad de/ gzhung 'di'i skabs kyi rnam bshad snying po rgyan las/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams ni nyan mongs spang bya'i gtso bor byas nas spong bas de'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes la zag med ces bya'o//zhes bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ dam bca' de'i phyir/ kha cig nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi gzhi shes la zag med zhes brjod rigs te/ nyan thos rnams kyis nyon sgrib spang bya'i gatho rwakur byas nas spong ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems 141

dpa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes la zag bcas zhes brjod rigs te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nyon sgrib spang bya'i gtso bor byas nas mi spong ba'i phyir/ zer na / nyan thos chos can/ khyodad nyan thos slob pa yin par thal/ khyod nyan thos gang zhig khyod kyis nyon sgrib spang bya'i gatho rwaper byed pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nu sa te/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa de khyod yin pa'i phyir/ byas pa la/ kho na re / der thal/ nyan thos kyi spang bya'i gtso bo yod pa'i phyir te/ byang sems kyi spang bya'i gtso bor sku da pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ kha cig shes sgrib nyan thos kyi spang bya'i gatho'i bo yin te/ shes sgrib nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i spang bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i spang bya'i gtso bo yod pa'i phyir te/ de'i spang bya yod pa'i phyir te/ de sems can yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ro/ /sbyor ba sgom pa wa'i rtenagyi gang zag bshad pa/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang sems tshogs lam pa chos can/ yum nyan pa'i snod rung gi gang zag yin te/ theg chen gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mgon dang bcas shing sdusan sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par bya ba byas pa sogs phyi nang gi rkyen gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' yin pa'i phyir/ kho 142

na re/ byang sems tshogs lam pa yin na yum nyan pa'i snod rung gi gang zag yin pas khyab par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sems tsam par gyur ba'i byang sems tshogs lam pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/zer na rtsa bar ma khyab/ gnyis pa la kha cig sbyor ba sgom pa'i phyi nang gi rkyen gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' de sbyor ba sgom pa gro'i rten gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ nyan thos tshogs lam pa chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ der thal/ nyan thos kyi sbyor ba sgom pa po'i rten gyi gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig mtshan nyid de rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sgom pa po'i rten gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid zer na/ de la skyon 'phen pa kha cig rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sgom pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ chos can de'i phyir/ zhes bkag nas/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i sbyor ba sgom pa wa'i rten gyi gang zag yin na byang chub sems dpa' yin pas khyab zer ba nang 'gal te/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i sbyor ba sgom pa po'i lam ma zhug sa kyi gang zag chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i rnam rdzogs rjodar ba sgom pa gro'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te / rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sgom pa wa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir/rtags khas/ rtsa bar 'dod na sla/ rang lugs la sbyor ba sgom pa'i phyi nang 143

gi rkyen gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems dpa' de/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sgom pa wa'i rten gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ byang sems skye 'phags gnyis su yod/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi 〉rgags lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na sku/da/byang sems kyi rje ra ba nyi shu bshad pa/gzugs la sdu/gas la mi gnas phyir/ /zhes lha/gas kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor ba la nyi shu yod de/ sbyor ba rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba lnga / rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas dbye ba brgyad/ sbyor ba rdzogs pa'i thabs kyi sbru/ nas phye ba bzhi/ 'bras bu dang dus kyi sgo nas phye ba gsum sku da pa'i phyir/ dang po grub te/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba/ gnas pa bkag pa'i ྅kkor ba/ zab pa'i tshular ba 1 gting dpag dka' ba'i sbyor ba/ tshad med pa'i khyodar ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas brgyad sku da de/ tshigs chen yun ring rtogs dka'i sbyor ba/ lung bstan thob pa'i sbyor ba/ phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba / nges par 'byung ba'i sbyor ba/ bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba/ byang chub la nye ba'i sbyor ba/ myur ba'i sbyor ba/ gzhan don gyi sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i 144

phyir/ sbyor ba rdzogs pa'i thabs kyi sgo nas bzhi yod de/ 'phel 'grib med pa'i sbyor ba/ chos dang snuswās min sogs mi mthong ba'i khyodar ba/ gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab mi mthong ba'i sbyor ba/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i sbyor ba rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu dang dus kyi sgo nas gsum yod de/ 'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed kyi sbyor ba dang / rnam par dag pa'i khyodar ba/ sa mtshams dang bcas pa'i sbyor ba rnams su sku da pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig yul yul can gzhi lam rnam gsum bden stong spros bral du sgom pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid zer na/ skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i tshegs chen yun ring rtogs dka'i sbyor ba chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ masnuran bya de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ stong nyid la skrag pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la skrag pa dang zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ kha cig yul yul can gzhi lam rnam gsum bden stong spros bral du sgom pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gatho rwape sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid zer ba mi 'thad de/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bajod chos can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ dman lam sngon du song ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/145

rang lugs ni/ stong nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi shes rab kyis zin pa'i skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i gatho rwaku sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu dgu yod/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam drod nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i sbyor ba la nyi shu/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar na sku/da/spyor ba'ilonatan bcu bzhi bshad pa/bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba'i mo na tan la bcu bzhi yod de/sbyor ba sgom pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi mthu bcom pa sogs bcu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ mi 'thad de/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud la sbyor ba'i sku na tan yod pa'i phyir te/ nyan thos 'phags pa'i rgyud la sbyor ba yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig mtshan nyid de theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba dang dus mnyam du gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i yon tan chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/146

mtshon bya de'i phyir/ rtags grub ste/ chos can de yod pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba dang dus mnyam yin pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyi thob pa'i phan yon de/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i skusgon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na bcu bzhi yod/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam skad cig gnyis pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na sku/da/ rtsod pa spong ba la kha cig rnam mkhyen snums can/ mtshon bya der thal/ mtshan nyid de'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ byang sems kyi yon tan yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ zer na / ma khyab/ yang de chos can/ gnas skabs kyi sku1na tan yin par thal/theg chen sbyor ba'i yon tan yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ ma khyab ste/ rnam mkhyen chos can/ byang sems kyi byed pa yin par thal/ theg chen gyi ༄/ma lam gyi byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa sku/nga / rgyun mtha'i ye shes chodas can/ mthar thug gi yum yin par thal/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i yum yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa corshas can/ gnas skabs kyi skyabs yin par thal/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyabs yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ yang kha cig mtshan nyid mi 'thad par thal/ rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon rgyud la ldan pa'i lam 147

ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom nga/'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te/ theg chen sems bskyed sgom pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ zhes bkag nas/ kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor ba thob myong ba'i gang zag gi rgyud kyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon de theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ zhes gsungs pa dang / kha cig rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i sems dpa'i yon tan 'dir bstan sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid du bzhag nas rnam rtso gas khyodar ba sgom pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod zhes zer/ lugs dang po la re zhig mtshan nyid de mi 'thad par thal/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba thob myong gi gang zag gi rgyud kyi theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon rgyud la ldan pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba thob myong gi gang zag gi rgyud kyi theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom pa'i lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag yod pa gang zhig theg chen gyi sbyor ba dang theg chen gyi sbyor ba thob myong gi rgyud kyi sbyor ba gnyis yin khyab mnyam yin pa'i phyir/ lugs gnyis pa la yang mi 'thad de / rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sgom byed kyi blo la brten nas jo ba pa'i sems dpa'i yon tan yin na 'dir bstan ྅7ra ba'i yon 148

tan yin dgos par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'asnga da na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba skad cig dang sngo chodas can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags ma grub na song / der thal/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud kyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sgom byed kyi sgo de rnam rdzogs sbyor ba skad cig dang po thob byed kyi thabs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud la rnam ljangags sbyor ba sgom byed kyi blo yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ 'dir bstan sbyor ba'i yon tan thob pa la rnam rdzogs sbyor ba thob pa sngon du 'gro mi dbo sa par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi cadam lam gyi byed pa rgyud la skye ba la theg chen gyi sgom lam thob pa sngon du 'gro mi dbo sa par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba skad cig dang po thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sku da par thal/ rnam rdzogs rjodar ba skad cig dang po de rang thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sgom byed kyi blo la brten nas jo ba pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'asnga da na/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang zag gi rgyud la rnam rdzogs sbyor ba sku da par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ zer na rtsa bar ma khyab/ kho na re/ theg chen gyi rjodar ba sgom rdo bas kyis thob pa'i phan yon yin na/ theg chen gyi rje/ra ba'i sku/na tan yin dbo/sa par thal/ mtshan nyid de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'awa da na/ theg chen gyi rjodar ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ ma grub na/ theg chen gyi rjodar ba ma sgom 119

par theg chen gyi sbyor ba thob pa yod par thal/ ma grub pa de'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba chos can/ khyod khyod kyi sku na tan ma yin par thal/ bdag med yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer na theg chen gyi sbyor ba de de'i yon tan du grags kyang zhib tu dpyad na mi 'thad de/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba skad cig gnyis pa rgyud la skyes pa dang theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i yon tan thob pa dus mnyam pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba skad cig dang sngo la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud la theg chen sbyor ba'i yon tan med par thal/ gong gi sa mtshams de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud la de yod par thal/ de'i rgyud la theg chen sbyor ba mi rtag pa yod pa gang zhig theg chen rjodar ba mi rtag pa theg chen gyi rje/ra ba'i sku/na tan yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ de de'i khyad chos yin pa'i phyir/ tshad ma rnam 'grel las/ de phyir dngos po mthong pa yi/ /yon tan mtha' dag mthong ba nyid/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ zer na ma khyab/ shes bya chos can/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba skad cig dang po la gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rgyud la theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i phan yon yod par thal/ de'i rgyud la theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i yon tan yod pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud la theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i 'bras bu yod par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang de'i 'bras bu yin khyab mnyam yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khe na re/ lam ma zhugs kyi gang 150

zag gi rgyud kyi mngon mtho'i then 'phang de sangs rgyas kyi sku/na tan yin par thal/de sangs rgyas la brten nas thob pa'i phyir/ khyab te/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba la brten nas thob pa'i sku(na tan yin na/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i yon tan yin dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags dngos/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ sangs rgyos kyi rgyud kyis bsdus par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ zer na mi mtshungs sa/ / sbyor ba'i skyon zhe drug bshad pa/skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa/ /zhes sdu/gas kyi skabs su/ lju ra ba dang /mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ sbyor ba'i skyon de la bzhi bcu rtsa drug sku da de 1 sbyor ba'i 'gal rkyen rang la brten pa nyi shu/ rang gzhan gang rung la brten pa mthun rkyen ma tshang ba nyer gsum/ khyodar ba'i 'gal rkyen gzhan la brten pa gsum sku da pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la kha cig sbyor ba skye ba dang gnas pa la bar du gcod pa'i bdud las de sbyor ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid zer na/ byang sems chorags lam pa'i rgyud kyi rjordzor ba'i skyodan chodas can/ mtshan nyid der thal/mtshon bya de'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ sbyor ba skye ba la bar du gcod byed yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'aro/da na/ byang sems chorags lam 151

pa'i rgyud la sbyor ba skye ba la bar du gcod byed kyi bdud las yod par thal/'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de'i rgyud la sbyor ba skyes ma zin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs ni/ sbyor ba skye ba dang gnas pa dang / rdzogs pa gang rung la bar du gcod pa'i bdud las de sbyor ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na / zhe drug yod/ sa mtshams lam ma zhugs nas sa bdun pa'i bar na yod/sbyor ba'i shes bya'i mtshan nyid bshad pa/gang gis mtshon de mtshan nyid du/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ sbyor ba dang / mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi thob byar gyur ba'i 'bras bu sher phyin thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor chos can/ khyod la mtshan nyid ces pa'i sgras brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor mtshon byed yin pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba sku gas gzhi shes kyi rnam pa gang yang rung ba la dmigs pa yang yin theg dman gyi skadags rigs su gnas pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun par gyur ba'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor chos can/ khyod la mtshan nyid ces pa'i sgras brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan sku da de/ stu da kyis sems dpa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba de mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ stong nyid mtshan ma med pa 152

sogs lam shes kyi rnam pa gang yang rung ba la dmigs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor chodas can/ khyod la mtshan nyid ces pa'i sgras bcadad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de / khyod kyis lam shes kyi sbyor ba mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyi mthong chos la bde bar gnas pa sogs rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang yang rung ba la dmigs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de chos can/ khyod la mtshan nyid ces pa'i sgras ston pa'i rgyu mtshan sku/da de/ khyod kyis rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ bsam mi khyab sogs kyi khyad par du byas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor chodas can/ khyod la mtshan nyid ces pa'i sgras ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod kyis nyan rang gi sbyor ba las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rjodar ba de mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/ phan bde lhamab sogs kyi byed las khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor chos can/ khyod la mtshan nyid ces pa'i sgras ston pa'i rgyu mtshan sku da de/ sdudad kyis gzhan sngonan sgrub pa'i byed las khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba mtshon par byed pa'i phyir/sems dpa'i rgyud kyi ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor bcu drug chos can/ khyod la mtshan nyid ces pa'i sgras ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod kyis sems dpa'i sbyor ba bcu drug mcho na par byed pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar bswā da pa'i phyir/kho na re/ gang gis mtshon te mtshan nyid du/ /shes bya de yang rnam pa gsum//zhes smos pa la dgos pa med par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ zer 153

na / mtshan nyid ni rnam pa bzhir shes par bya'o/ /zhes bshad pa mi 'thad par tha la/ sbyor ba de gzhung 'di'i don sbyor rnam dag ma yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/stutshod la shes mtshan/ khyad mtshan/ byed mtshan/ ngo bo nyid mtshan rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ zer na/ shes mtshan de theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin par thal/ sbyor ba de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chodas can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ mtshan nyid ma yin pa'i phyir/ des gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'dre/ gzhan yang /theg chen gyi sbyor ba chos can/ khyod kyi swā ga pa yin pa du ma yod par thal/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid yin pa du ma sku/da pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ gnyis pa la kha cigasnying rje chen po dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs thabs shes kyi rigs rdzogs pas zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid/ zer na/ stong nyid rtogs ma myong ba'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi kun rdzob sems skyed chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ mtshon bya de'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ 'bras bu sher phyin thob byed kyi thabs su gyur ba'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyis zin pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ chos can de'i phyir/ kho na re/ rnam bshad snying po rgyan las/ nyon mongs rtags sogs kyis dben pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor 151

bcu drug mtshan gzhi/ lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor du mtshon/ snying rje chen po dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab sogs thabs shes khyad par can gyi rigs rdzogs pas zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes sdud ges bshad pa mi 'thad par thal/ mtshan nyid de mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes zer na/ ma khyab te/ de ltar bshad pa go ba rigs pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi lam sher phyin gyi rnal 'byor gyi mtshan nyid/ lus rnam bzhag gi ṭikar bshad pa ltar khas len rigs pa'i phyir/ kha cig theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i nus pa mtshon byed kyi rtogs pa de theg chen gyi khyodar ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na/ shes mtshan/byed mtshan/ khyad mtshan rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ zer na/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor chos can/ khyod theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid yin par thal/ khyod theg chen sbyor ba'i nus pa mtshon byed kyi rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na der thal/ shes mtshan yin pa'i phyir/ sems dpa'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes sbyor ba'i shes mtshan yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chos can/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin par thal/ khyod theg chen gyi sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ gzhan yang / shes mtshan de mtshan nyid yin par thal/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid la gsum wa der 'byed rigs pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid de mtshan nyid yin par thal/ 'dod 155

pa'i phyir/ kho na re/ skyon snga ma de mi 'jug ste/ mtshan mtshon la khyab pa sgo bzhi rtsi ba gang las kyang ma bshad pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / mi rtag pa bum pa'i spyi'i mtshan nyid/ lto ldir ba bum pa'i rang gi mtshan nyid yin par thal/bum pa'i spyi'i mtshan nyid dang / bum pa'i rang gi mtshan nyid gzhi grub pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ka ba chos can/ bum pa'i spyi yin par thal/ mi rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khyod kyi lugs la dngos/ gzhan yang theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor chos can/ khyod shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par thal/ khyod shes mtshan yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad mkhyen pa gsum gyi dbye bas tha dad pa la zhes bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na song / sgra rtag 'dzin rtog pa chos can/ theg dman gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor yin pa thal/ shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khyod ltar na dngos zhes zer na/ thal 'gyur phyi ma gnyis kyi rtsa bar ma khyab/ mtshon tshul la mkhas pa kha cig dang / lo tsa ba chen spro ni byang sems kyi rjordzor ba nyi shu mtshan gzhi yin/ de ni gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir/ /zhes 11gas kyis bstan/ chos sku'i rgyu thun mong ma yin pa mtshon bya yin la/ de ni nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang / /zhes 11gas kyis bstan/ don gnyis phun tshogs sgrub byed kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de mtshan nyid yin la/ de ni bsam mi khyab sku/gas khyad par gyi/ /zhes sogs 156
