ba rnams kyis gros mthun gyi sbru/ nas/ 7bo/nga sa thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen sngo skyabs mgon sho je 'chang la gnas tshul gyi dacadas sngo snyan gsol phul ba na/ dam pa nyid nas kyang thugs kyi cad ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang 'grogs pas zhal ras 'dzum dkar gyi snang ba spro bzhin/ rin chen gnyis pa srang lnga bcu'i gnang sbyin dang / bkod khyab kyi bka' lung 'gyur med bden tshig gi me tog spyi bor stsal ba bzhin phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwa chen po rong wa'i lnga sa bsam gling gi bshes gnyen rnams kyis 'dzin grwa sku so dang / nang khag che chung / gzhan stod smad bar gsum gyi/ dngul nom gos phrug ja mar la sku gas pa'i rdzas rnams bsdus nas mthun rkyen gang 'jo/mas sbyar zhing /btsan mo'i sde ba stod smad gnyis kyis dpar shing cha tshang ba legs par phul te / dpar yig zhus dag pa gzhung brgya smra ba'i dbang phyug chen po sgang gi dato/na mchodag lhun grub/ bra thod sku na tan rgya mcho la 1/gas pa'i dge bshes 'ga' re dang / par yig pa gnyan lnga ga sngags 'chang dpal bzang / par bsgo sa pa sgo dmar dge slong bsam 'grub rgya mtsho/ tho rgya'i dge slong brtson 'grus/ sgo dmar sngags 'chang tso'u ri/ rgya mtsho/ shes rab la sogs pa'i skyes bu du mas 'bad brtsol dang dad gus kyi sor mo'i 'du byed kyis mchog tu bskrun te/rab byung bco lnga'i bgrang bya srin wa shes pa shing mo yos kyi gnam lo gsar tshes la mabo brtsams te/ dus kyi sku/ nya zhes pa sa 'o/ rta'i 'o// chu shel gyi dbang sngo 425

chu stod nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi stong ba dang po/ dbyangs 'char gyi dbyangs e gsal byed pa 'tshar ba'i chos la mjug ljaḍags par grub pa'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang rig pa smra ba sgang gi byams pa 'phrin las kyis gathoras dpar du sgrub pa'i dge bshes rnams kyis thun snu/nga nas par byang blo na tshig cig kyang dgos zhes ras yug bub gcig dang / bkra shis pa'i lha dar che legs bcas nan ta na chen pos bskul ngor bzlog ma phod par/ 7shar bla brang chen mo nor bu gru 'dzin gyi srid skyong gi las khur 'dzin pa myur chung sprul ming pa blo bzang rgya mtshos bris partsordo// //par byang blon tshig༈ོ rnam grol zhi ba'i rgya mcho ra ro gcig tu/ /gzhol ba'i mtha' yas chos tshul dal 'bab klung / /tshig gi gzigs ma res kyang dug gsum gyi/ /dri ma yongs 'khrud legs bshad bdud rtsi'adi/ /dpar du bskrun pa'i rnam dkar phung bo'i mthus/ /yang dag chos kyi sgo mo stong phrag brgya/ /gdangs te rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /nges legs nor bu'i mdzod la dbang 'byor shog/ces 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la 'tshe med zhi ba'i lam ston rnam 'dren shākya seṅge'i ring lugs ༄/ kun nas rgyas pa sku/gas 'phral yul legs snumags du ma'i ched du dmigs/ /nang 426

bstan grub mtha' ris med kyi gsung rab dag dpar du bskrun dang bskrun 'gyur gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i dge bsngo'i spyodan tshig tu shākya'i dge rjodang chos smra ba ngag dbang chod bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mcho sa sbyar bcardo// //sarba maṅga waṃ//dga' byang mdzub gcadan blo ga pu'i dpe sgrig sde tshan gyis phyi 'o/ 2000 zla 5 tshes 15 nyin sngo/da phreng bcu gcig pa zhu bsgrigs zhus//

bstan grub mtha' ris med kyi gsung rab dag dpar du bskrun dang bskrun 'gyur gang la'ang sbyar chog pa'i dge bsngo'i spyodan tshig tu shākya'i dge rjodang chos smra ba ngag dbang chod bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mcho sa sbyar bcardo// //sarba maṅga waṃ//dga' byang mdzub gcadan blo ga pu'i dpe sgrig sde tshan gyis phyi 'o/ 2000 zla 5 tshes 15 nyin sngo/da phreng bcu gcig pa zhu bsgrigs zhus//

༈ོོ na ma dkaro 'di yis ma tha' klas zhing kun gyi/ /snad btsod 'byar ba phul du byung ba dang / /ba/kha drin zhing mchog bzhi yi dri lan 'khor/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang sar nam yang mi ltung zhing / /'di la thos sogs bgyid pa'i 'brel thogs kun/ /byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsigashesargyud brlan/ /'di snang 'gags tshe dag pa'i zhing bzang du/ /brdzus te skyes nas don gnyisamathar phyin shag /ces pa 'di yang par skrun gyi byabazhaga'adir 'gro gron gtong mkhan dang / legasabashad 'di nyid 'dzin 'chang klog pa sogs kyi dge bsngo'i smon tshig tu bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅga lam̐/ /eo nam amitābhās/: spar 'grem dang mthun 'gyur sbyor mkhan/thā'i wan nang pa'i shes yon bde ༅lhan tshogs/phyag deb 'di bzhin rin med du 'grem spel byed pa las tshong bsgyur byed mi chogaspar skrun byed yul thā'i wan/
dbe deb 'di rin med ngang 'grem 'bul byed pa las chong bsgyur byed mi chogatshuno nam amitadhaya/'a'aphyag da pe 'di chos sbyin du 'bul rgyu las/tshong bsgyur mi chog pa dgongs 'jags zhu/
